name: R.U.B.Y. Xunchang Jiaozhi de Richang
source:
Four ordinary stories about four ordinary girls.

Sometimes, people's lives intertwine without anyone realizing it, resulting in subtle changes to their daily routines.

Sometimes these changes are so small that people don't notice them.
Other times, the changes can be drastic, catching people off guard...

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169230/]Steam[/url]]
